name: button-group
title: ButtonGroup
description: Buttons sit flush so related actions read as one control. Use for aligned toolbars, not free-floating CTAs.

discovery.name: ButtonGroup
discovery.description: Buttons sit flush so related actions read as one control. Use for aligned toolbars, not free-floating CTAs.

configurables.how: horizontal for toolbars; vertical for stacked mobile actions. Default: horizontal.

gotchas.note: Children must be Button/IconButton siblings — spacing is owned by the group, not ad-hoc margins.
